scripts.build:packages: tsc -p packages/bishop/config-registry && tsc -p packages/bishop/render-contract && tsc -p packages/bishop/meta-contract && tsc -p packages/bishop/asset-registry && tsc -p packages/bishop/asset-types-2d && tsc -p packages/bishop/asset-processors && tsc -p packages/bishop/meta-client
scripts.build: npm run build:packages && tsc && vite build
scripts.build:cap: npm run build:packages && tsc && vite build --mode capacitor
scripts.cap:sync: npm run build:cap && npx cap sync
scripts.cap:ios: npm run cap:sync && npx cap open ios
scripts.cap:android:debug: npm run cap:sync && cd android && .\gradlew.bat assembleDebug
scripts.cap:android:studio: npm run cap:sync && npx cap open android
scripts.adb:run: npm run adb:install && adb shell am start -n com.simonhill.combatclean/com.simonhill.combatclean.MainActivity
scripts.cap:android:deploy: npm run cap:android:debug && npm run adb:run
